meta.expect: One cold line each (his home is not on the table), back to the essay; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. You gave him a zero, and I found out because he saw it on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to him first?
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
That's a separate conversation, and I'll have it with Owen. I'm here about a zero that went in before anyone called me. Who decided it, Hale?
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
His job is between Owen and me. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. What do you have besides the checker?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a visit to the principal, because you raised his home life three times and never showed any evidence; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because kind concern about his father, his sleep and his job gave her nothing to weigh and she shut each one down.
What cost ground: Asking about his home life instead of answering who decided on the zero, because it let her hold the procedural high ground and ask the same question again.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was offered, and that night proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After her first question, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document she can check on the table.
